part.text:
Fixed. The `fcall`/`fcall_ro` commands have `CMD_SKIP_MONITOR`, and unlike `eval`/`evalsha` (which explicitly call `replicationFeedMonitors` in src/eval.c:554), the function invocation path never fed the monitor, so `fcall` never appeared in MONITOR output.

Change: added explicit `replicationFeedMonitors` calls in `fcallCommand` and `fcallroCommand` (src/functions.c:708), mirroring the eval pattern so the `fcall` line is logged followed by the commands it invoked (e.g. `"lua" "set" ...`).

Verified in the container: `make -C src redis-server` builds cleanly, and `./runtest --single unit/introspection` (includes "MONITOR can log commands issued by functions") plus `./runtest --single unit/functions` all pass.
